1. Executive Capability Statement & Engineering Authority Delivering Mission-Critical Enterprise Platforms

Wazema Solutions PLC is a high-growth software engineering and enterprise digital systems consultancy based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We architect, engineer, and deploy high-concurrency systems, cross-platform mobile ecosystems for competitive international markets (including official DVSA-licensed theory suites in the United Kingdom), custom enterprise resource planning (ERP) suites, and full-stack contactless restaurant platforms. Every system in our portfolio is engineered for production reliability, real-time throughput, and scalable performance.

Core Engineering Disciplines & Architectural Pillars
⚙ High-Concurrency Microservices
Ultra-low latency Node.js, Go, and Python/FastAPI backends with Redis clustering, WebSocket live event pipelines, and PostgreSQL read-replicas handling millions of requests.
📱 International Mobile Suites & Cloud CMS
Dual iOS & Android apps (Flutter / Native) paired with proprietary cloud CMS admin portals allowing client non-technical staff to update content dynamically with zero app store delays.
💳 Multi-Rail FinTech & Payment Switches
Direct API routing across Telebirr, CBE Birr, Chapa, Awash Bank, and international card rails with sub-second response times, automated ledger reconciliation, and fraud prevention.
🏭 Custom ERP, Supply Chain & IoT Telemetry
Multi-department procurement workflows, serialized barcode inventory, GPS cross-corridor fleet telemetry, and industrial factory yield accounting built for operational efficiency.
